styleLock.direction: sweet-pop girls street apparel commerce, candy color blocking with clean infographic discipline
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless paper sweep #FFFFFF for packshots and variant flat lays, peach-sugar panel #FDE3E7 for benefit and spec screens, cream studio board #F0EAE2 for numbered construction screens, neutral board #E7E1DA beside macro frames, disused railway and shutter street fields #A8563F / #B7A495 / #DAD7D2 only for the two worn lifestyle screens; one flat cherry block #E0475A may carry one headline, one block per screen, never a gradient and never a hue outside this list
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm daylight-balanced key around 5200K from the upper left, large softbox diffusion with a bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadow under every hem and folded edge, raking side light only on the two texture macro screens, no harsh speculars, no cool cast
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte paper sweep #FFFFFF, cream studio board #F0EAE2, neutral board #E7E1DA, weathered wooden sleeper #B7A495 with grey ballast gravel #C9C5BF for worn screens; garment faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free, no debris inside the frame
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label plus one rounded heavy display weight reserved for the two poster screens only; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-48pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters, no serif, handwritten or retro faces and no painted wall lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #2B2428 plus solid circular index chips in #E0475A on the numbered detail screens; no filled emblems, no seal realism, no certificate artwork, no badge wording
styleLock.presentationRules: keep one garment scale and one slight 3/4 worn angle across the set so the outfit reads as the same pair; flat lays stay perfectly square to the frame; both pieces of the set appear together whenever the outfit is shown; every child model is a generic body cropped at the neck or seen from behind, never an identifiable face
noDrift: no new colorway outside the two reference colorways
no logo, wordmark or brand mark on garment, cap or bag
no identifiable child face in any screen
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet-pop girls street apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless paper sweep #FFFFFF, peach-sugar panel #FDE3E7, cherry accent #E0475A and label ink #2B2428; warm daylight-balanced softbox key around 5200K from the upper left with bounce fill and true contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one rounded heavy display weight on poster screens only; thin single-weight line icons plus solid circular index chips in #E0475A; clean high-end children apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 worn angle and garment scale, generic child model cropped at the neck or seen from behind; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实（9 屏）：1 铁轨道砟上全身正面街拍首屏加大字报与第二配色缩略图；2 两格全身拼贴加中文栏目标题与拉丁小字副题、编号 1 领口圆形放大窗；3 编号 1 领口、2 图案、3 裤腰三格圆形放大窗加斜切白底色块；4 面料解析屏（粉绿针织卷成旋涡加大量水汽、四个圆形小图标、黑白车缝工序三小图）；5 信息 X 尺码屏（基本信息四行、厚薄弹力柔软版型四档指数条、洗护图标三行、七档尺码表与九列实测数值）；6 铁轨上迈步动态全身加大英文标语；7 卷帘门正面全身、90 度侧面行走、头部特写三格加理念小字；8 颈以下裁切半身加平铺上衣与领口圆形放大镜；9 上衣平铺正面与背面两格，各带一个圆形放大镜与标签条。品类判定依据：以图为准，逐屏主体都是外穿搭配语境（铁轨、卷帘门、柏油路、运动鞋、遮阳帽、小斜挎包）的两件套——宽版直条纹撞色圆领短袖上衣加水洗做旧卷边牛仔七分裤，不是贴身衣、睡衣或家居服，故不取「内衣家居服/儿童内衣」；也不是鞋或玩具，故不取「鞋靴/童鞋」与「母婴/玩具」；与文件夹名童装一致，取 L1「母婴」/ L2「童装」，productFamily 按服饰取 fashion。已剥离：原店铺、品牌与英文标语字样以及帽子与斜挎包上的商标图形；上衣胸前大幅人物图案与裤腿卡通贴布绣的具体图文（只保留“胸前矩形图位”“裤身小贴布”结构描述，具体图案一律交给用户上传参考图经 {product_identity_lock} 承载），且原图含持枪成人化图形，模版已删除并在每镜 negative 中明令禁止武器与夜生活类图形；全部原文案句子与栏目标题（卖点句、面料比喻句、年份新款字样、装饰性英文小字、设计师签名）；童模的面容与身份（改为颈部以下裁切、背面或平铺，不臆造身材与年龄）；上衣与裤子的尺码表九列数值、四档指数选中位、适穿区间、洗涤温度与提示条目均改 {callout_N} 或空白格子；面料成分百分比、克重、A 类与抗菌类检测、销量与认证一律未写入。机位节奏：90 度俯拍（主图与选色屏复用）、3/4 上身、平视正面双格（痛点屏与参数屏复用）、仰视铁轨、背面 45 度、高 45 度三格、擦地侧光微距、90 度侧面堆叠，共 7 类机位，无连续 3 镜同机位；背景在 #FFFFFF、#FDE3E7、#F0EAE2、#E7E1DA 与户外 #A8563F / #DAD7D2 之间交替。与库内同系列两套的差异（逐条）：(a) 与 suite-muying-nantong-yinhuatxu-micai-gongzhuangku 相比，本套是女童宽版直条纹加洗水牛仔、对方是男童印花短袖加迷彩工装，视觉体系由荧光黄 #F0D800 加军绿 #5A6B47 加墨色 #1F1F1F 的街头体系换为蜜桃糖霜 #FDE3E7 加樱桃 #E0475A 的暖调糖果体系，道具由滑板与水泥台阶换为铁轨道砟与卷帘门，并新增“背面 45 度”与“堆叠 90 度侧面”两个对方未用的机位；(b) 与 suite-muying-nantong-jiajianliang-diaodangku-taozhuang 相比，对方走冷调海风（#1E9FC0 湖青、#C9CDD0 水泥灰、#BEE4EE 海岸面板、橡木板）并以假两件结构与痛点屏为叙事主轴，本套为 warm 暖调糖果色板、无海岸面板也无吊裆结构，叙事主轴换成“上下两件一套穿好 + 三格编号圆窗亮点 + 实物工艺堆叠收口”；(c) 两套已有件都以 CTA 促销屏收口，本套因源图末屏就是平铺放大镜细节屏，改为 TRUST 走线做工收口，且镜数取 10 镜（对方为 9 镜与 11 镜），细节屏用“圆形放大窗加编号圆片”语法而非对方的双向引线标注与三格无圆窗语法。
